provider_approval_type: approval by Office of the Attorney General (OAG)
applicable_to: commercial lodging establishments with 10 or more rooms
encourages training for all lodging establishments in Texas
recordkeeping_requirements: retention of records of completed training certificates for at least five years
making these records available upon request by the OAG or relevant law enforcement agencies
certificate_requirements: employers must provide a certificate of completion to each employee who completes the training
certificate must include the date of the course and the title of the course
harbor_alliance_actions: Training must include information on human trafficking signage required to be displayed in commercial lodging establishments.
risks_or_constraints: non-compliance with training requirements can result in penalties, including fines and legal action.
